title: Benthic Data Protocol Manifest
description: A BDP Manifest is a signed JSON document that proves who built a dataset, what code produced it, what shape the data has, and where it can be reached. It is transport-agnostic: the same manifest may advertise a live query API, static columnar files, or both. Consumers MUST verify the cryptographic_signature before trusting any other member of this document.

protocol_version.description: Semantic version of the BDP specification this manifest conforms to.

author_identity.description: Human-readable identity of the publisher. Not authenticated by itself; trust derives from author_pubkey.

author_pubkey.description: Ed25519 public key as the raw 32-byte key encoded with standard Base64 (with padding). This is NOT the OpenSSH 'ssh-ed25519 AAAA...' wire format.

dataset_name.description: Stable machine identifier for the dataset. Unique within a collection.

collection.description: Optional name of the BDP collection this dataset belongs to. Enables bidirectional verification against a signed collection document.

description.description: Human-readable summary of what the dataset contains.

license.description: License identifier or URL governing reuse of the data.

created_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp at which this manifest revision was generated.

schema_definition.description: Curated allowlist of relations that form the published data contract. A relation absent from this array is NOT part of the contract even if a transport happens to expose it.

endpoints.description: Available transport methods for reaching this dataset. At least one is required.

etl_provenance.description: Binds the dataset to the exact public source code that produced it, so an auditor can reproduce it.

repository_url.description: URI of the publicly readable source repository containing the ETL code.

commit_hash.description: Full Git commit SHA (SHA-1 40 hex, or SHA-256 64 hex) of the revision that produced this dataset.

pipeline_entrypoint.description: Repository-relative path to the executable entrypoint that builds this dataset.

built_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of the ETL run that produced the currently served data.

migration_status.description: Honest declaration of how tightly commit_hash binds the served data. 'pending' means the referenced repository does not yet contain the code that produced the live data; provenance is aspirational and MUST NOT be treated as reproducible. 'in_progress' means partial migration. 'migrated' means commit_hash fully reproduces the served data.

migrated_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp at which migration_status became 'migrated'.

source_attribution.description: Upstream data sources consumed by the pipeline.

relation.description: A single table, view, materialized view, callable function, or file within the dataset.

provenance.description: Origin of this relation. 'upstream' = shipped by the external source unchanged. 'derived' = produced by the ETL code referenced in etl_provenance. 'recovered' = exists in the served system but its defining DDL was reconstructed by introspection rather than taken from version-controlled source; treat its reproducibility as unproven.

queryable.description: Whether this relation is reachable through the declared endpoints. Relations are declared even when false so that the full provenance lineage is auditable.

row_count_estimate.description: Advisory only. Never authoritative; omitted when the source system cannot supply a trustworthy estimate.

native_type.description: Native type string from the originating engine, e.g. 'numeric(23,2)' or 'GEOMETRY(Point,4326)'.

srid.description: Spatial reference identifier. REQUIRED by convention when type is 'geometry'.

unit.description: Unit of measure for numeric columns, e.g. 'USD'.

base_url.description: Root URI of the API, storage bucket, content identifier, or gRPC service.

meta.description: Transport-specific settings. Intentionally open (additionalProperties true) so that new transports do not require a schema revision. The properties below are the conventional keys.

accept_profile.description: PostgREST schema exposed via the Accept-Profile / Content-Profile header.

payload_hash.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 canonical form of this document with the cryptographic_signature member REMOVED.

signature_base64.description: Standard Base64 (with padding) of the 64-byte Ed25519 signature computed over the 32 RAW bytes of the SHA-256 digest, never over its hex representation.
